findings.title: Allergen awareness training for CFPM
findings.comment:
Observed no CFM present to have completed the required Allergen training. Discussed with PIC, ensure all CFM’s have completed the required Allergen training and said licenses are available within facility. 

410 ILCS 625/3.07(b). Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Training programs must be accredited by the American National Standards Institute or another reputable accreditation agency under the ASTM International E2659-09 (Standard Practice for Certificate Programs). There is no limit to how many times an employee may take the training.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Upon arrival, inspector observed dishes to be washed in the front hand sink. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper dish washing and practice was stopped. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used for hand washing, and that dishes are put through the wash, rinse, and sanitize process.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed Sammy eggs to be resting at 70F, eggs were prepared 2 hours before. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper cold holding/cooling and eggs were moved to cooler. Education was provided on possibly placing eggs under a TAC, however PIC decided on cold holding the eggs. Ensure any TCS item is being cold held at or below 41F
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed in use quiche to not have date marking available. Discussed with PIC, quiche was prepared within the last 7 days. Education on proper date marking was provided and date was placed on quiche. Ensure any TCS item kept longer than 24 hours has the required date marking available.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: Observed staff handling ready to eat food without glove wear. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper food handling and glove wear. Ensure staff is wearing gloves when in contact with RTE foods to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed utensils in back hand sink. Discussed with PIC, utensil was removed from hand sink. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used for handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
